description: Parliament of Sri Lanka - Summoning of Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Saturday,  the 16th of July 2022 at 10.00 a.m.
reasoning: This gazette content specifically concerns the summoning of Parliament due to a vacancy in the office of President, as per the Presidential Elections (Special Provisions) Act. This directly relates to electoral processes and the constitutional procedures for filling a presidential vacancy, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
